name: olio.cb.book
label: ChapBook
description: A poetry ChapBook: a PictureBook 2 variant where each scene page shows a stanza of poetry overlaid on a landscape image. Inherits all olio.pb.book fields plus ChapBook-specific layout controls.

fields.name: maxLinesPerPage
fields.description: Maximum lines per stanza chunk. No schema default — ChapBookUtil uses 8 when null.

fields.name: overlayOpacity
fields.description: Opacity of the background landscape image behind the poem text overlay. No schema default — renderer uses 0.4 when null.
